lines.japanese: 我、奈落より帰還せり。
lines.english: “I have returned from the abyss.”

lines.japanese: もはは、久方ぶりの玉座だ、悪くない。
lines.english: “Mohaha! The throne, after so long. Not unpleasant.”

lines.japanese: ほう、貴様が最後の子か。初めて逢ったな、姿なき者よ、もの言わぬ末弟よ。
lines.english: “Oh? So you are the last child. This is our first meeting, bodiless one—silent youngest brother.”

lines.japanese: だが残念！　遠路はるばる生まれてきたところ悪いが、俺が戻ったいま、もはや貴様の果たすべき任はない。下がってよいぞ。
lines.english: “What a shame! You have come such a long way to be born, but now that I have returned, there is no duty left for you. You may withdraw.”

lines.japanese: かつての約束とやらは余の与り知らぬところだ。我らのまつりごとは、王である余がすべて執りおこなう。
lines.english: “Old promises are no concern of mine. The affairs of state are mine alone to govern. I am king.”

lines.japanese: 生まれたての貴様は知らぬやもしれんが、グレタガルドの正統なる王位後継者は、ホークでもイーグルでもファルコンでも、ましてや貴様ごとき赤子でもない。
lines.english: “Newborn as you are, perhaps you do not know this: the rightful heir to Gretagard’s throne is not Hawk, or Eagle, or Falcon—least of all an infant like you.”

lines.japanese: 嫡男たる、この俺だ。
lines.english: “It is I: the firstborn son.”

lines.japanese: 余はガルーダ。愚弟どもに倣って当世に準じた名を騙るなら伊丹伽楼羅。
lines.english: “We are Garuda. If, like my foolish brothers, I were to adopt a name suited to this age, it would be Karura Itami.”

lines.japanese: 我こそが先代国王の第一子、はじまりの子だ。
lines.english: “I am the former king's first child—the child of beginnings.”

lines.japanese: さあ、もう良いだろう、おしまいの子よ。我が尊名を手土産に、底知れぬ魂の冥府へ下がれ。
lines.english: “Now, that is quite enough, child of the end. Take my august name as a parting gift and descend into the fathomless Hades of the soul.”

lines.japanese: どうした。聞こえなかったのか。俺は失せろと言ったぞ。
lines.english: “What is it? Did you not hear me? I told you to begone.”

lines.japanese: ふむん、そうか、気の毒に。産道に復路はなかったのか。
lines.english: “Hmm. I see. Poor creature. There was no way back through the birth canal, was there?”

lines.japanese: やむを得ん。ならばそうして、王の間の隅で永遠に膝を抱えていろ。終の子よ、無力な傍観者よ、しょせん貴様のうつろな眼など、俺にはなんの強制力ももたらさぬ。
lines.english: “It cannot be helped. Then sit forever in a corner of the throne room, hugging your knees. Final child. Helpless observer. Those hollow eyes of yours hold no power over me.”

lines.japanese: いや……あるいは王の退屈を凌ぐにはあつらえ向きかもしれんな。もの言えぬ貴様でも、伽の相手ぐらいは務められるだろう？
lines.english: “No... Perhaps thou art perfectly suited to relieve a king's tedium. Though thou canst not speak, surely thou canst at least serve as my companion?”

lines.japanese: くふふ、肌に感じる風は久しい。終の子よ、皮膚もたぬ子よ、せめて貴様にはこの風の冷たさを語りきかせてやろう。
lines.english: “Kuhuhu. It has been so long since I felt wind upon my skin. Final child, skinless child—at the very least, I shall tell you how cold this wind feels.”

lines.japanese: 見えるか？　いま俺の前には赤暗い世界が開けている。
lines.english: “Can you see it? A dark red world lies open before me now.”

lines.japanese: ときに愚弟よ、貴様は怒りというものを感じたことがあるか？
lines.english: “Tell me, foolish brother. Have you ever felt anger?”

lines.japanese: 粋がった若僧がたやすく口にのぼらせる“ブッ殺す”なんてのどかな比喩じゃない。もっと単純で原始的な、獣たらしい攻撃本能を覚えたことはあるか？
lines.english: “I do not mean the tame metaphor of ‘I’ll fucking kill you’ so readily tossed about by swaggering boys. Have you ever felt a simpler, more primitive, more animal urge to attack?”

lines.japanese: ないよなあ。俺以外には無理だよなあ。心中に濃密な憎悪が充満し、魂まで巨大な怨嗟に圧しつぶされたとき人間がどうなるか……怒りという感情の欠落した貴様らに知りうるはずがないよなあ。
lines.english: “Of course not. No one but me could. When the heart is saturated with concentrated hatred and the soul itself crushed beneath colossal rancor, what becomes of a human being...? You who lack the emotion called anger could never know.”

lines.japanese: ははん、教えてやろう。耐えがたい怒りに晒されたとき、ひとはまず、たちの悪い公害病患者のように体じゅうガタガタ震えだすのだ。
lines.english: “Hah! I will tell you. When a person is exposed to unbearable anger, the whole body begins to shake like a victim of some hideous industrial pollution disease.”

lines.japanese: 顔面の筋肉は弛緩してどんな色男も台無し、胃が痙攣して反吐を撒きちらしながら激痛にのたうちまわる。もはは、まるで巨大な芋虫だ。
lines.english: “The muscles of the face go slack, ruining the handsomest man. The stomach convulses; he writhes in agony, spewing vomit everywhere. Mohaha! A colossal caterpillar.”

lines.japanese: 全身の細胞が沸騰して凍える。けたたましい無音が鼓膜を引きさき、鮮血色のまばゆい闇が網膜を焦がす。矛盾だらけの悪夢は自我をも塗りつぶし、いまそこに己が在るという根源的な認識さえ朧に融かす。
lines.english: “Every cell in the body boils and freezes. Deafening silence tears at the eardrums; dazzling darkness the color of fresh blood sears the retinas. This nightmare of contradictions paints over the self, blurring even the primal knowledge that one exists at all.”

lines.japanese: もし貴様がこんな最低のトリップを迎えたらどうする。
lines.english: “What would you do if you had a trip that bad?”

lines.japanese: ふぬん、分からぬだろう。先代の王も分からなかった。あの方は愚かにも、ほとばしる奔流に堰を立て、偽善と秩序と自らの意識とを必死で保たんと努めた。そのような抵抗など無用だというのに。
lines.english: “Hmph. You could not know. The former king did not know either. In his folly, he tried to dam the raging torrent, struggling desperately to preserve hypocrisy, order, and his own consciousness. But such resistance was needless.”

lines.japanese: 果たして彼はあっけなく悪夢の奔流に呑みこまれた。だが正解はそれだ。それでいい。本能の妨げになる自我など、とっとと削ぎおとしてしまえばいいのだ。
lines.english: “Sure enough, the torrent of nightmare swallowed him with ease. But that is the correct answer. That is as it should be. One need only strip away the self that obstructs instinct.”

lines.japanese: あとにはただ憎悪だけが残る。そこから先は自動的だ。残された黒い鬼火には新たな自我が宿り、血肉を得た憎悪は、偽善と秩序に縛られることなく忌むべき対象を排除する。
lines.english: “Afterward, nothing remains but hatred. From there, all proceeds automatically. A new self takes root in the black will-o'-the-wisp left behind, and hatred given flesh and blood eliminates the loathed object, unfettered by hypocrisy or order.”

lines.japanese: そうして生まれたのが、この、俺だ。
lines.english: “And thus was I born.”

lines.japanese: さあ、終の子よ、声なき末弟よ。夜ごと語りきかせてやろう、奈落より舞いもどった長兄の物語を。
lines.english: “Now, final child, voiceless youngest brother. Night after night, I shall tell thee the tale of the eldest brother who soared back from the abyss.”

lines.japanese: 我が治世はとこしえに続く。愚かな弟たちの魂は宿り木を失い、らもらもと世界の狭間を彷徨いつづけることだろう。
lines.english: “My reign shall endure forever. The souls of my foolish brothers will lose the host that housed them and wander lost and loose between worlds for all eternity.”

lines.japanese: 終の子よ、声なき末弟よ。もはや王宮に残るのは余とその方だけだ。
lines.english: “Final child, voiceless youngest brother. Only thou and We remain within the royal palace now.”

lines.japanese: この俺と、千一夜を共に。
lines.english: “Thou shalt share a thousand and one nights with me.”
